verifications.claim: Most Kroger stores will be open on Easter Sunday, April 5, 2026, with regular operating hours.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Yes, most stores owned by Kroger should be open their normal hours on Easter'; R2: 'a majority of Kroger grocery stores will be open during regular business hours'; R3: 'stores will be open regular hours on Sunday, April 5'; R4: 'Kroger stores are open on Easter Sunday and operate during regular hours'; R5: 'We’re Open This Easter With regular store hours.'
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources directly confirm most/majority Kroger stores open regular/normal hours on April 5, 2026 Easter Sunday.
